lines.en: My horn parts the hanging vines
Dry leaves rustle under my hooves
I toss my mane beneath the old trees
I dip my head to drink from the forest pool
Dew clings to the tip of my horn
My ears turn toward the wind
I listen quietly to the whole forest
I watch you from behind the ferns.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛追着你的影子转。

lines.en: My horn dips slightly toward you
There is no hostility in my eyes

lines.zh: 独角兽受了伤，浑身无力。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured, feeling weak.

lines.zh: 独角兽的角受了伤，流血不止。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion's horn is injured, bleeding heavily.

lines.zh: 独角兽的蹄子受伤了，行走困难。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion's hoof is injured, making it hard to walk.

lines.zh: 独角兽被箭射中，伤口疼痛。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured by an arrow, the pain unbearable.

lines.zh: 独角兽被陷阱困住，无法行动。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured by a trap, unable to move.

lines.zh: 独角兽受了伤，嘶鸣哀鸣。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured, making a mournful sound.

lines.zh: 独角兽的翅膀受伤，飞不起来了。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion's wings are injured, unable to fly.

lines.zh: 独角兽的尾巴受伤，垂了下来。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion's tail is injured, hanging down.

lines.zh: 独角兽的皮肤受伤，鲜血直流。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion's skin is injured, bleeding profusely.

lines.zh: 独角兽的身上有伤口，需要治疗。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion has wounds, needs healing.

lines.zh: 我用角吸引你，森林之魂!
lines.en: Draw you with my horn, forest soul!
Magic of the forest makes me shimmer.
Savor the magic meat from me.
Call of the depths of the forest!

lines.zh: 森林中的魔法使我们强大
lines.en: Magic of the forest makes us strong.

lines.zh: 森林中的魔法赐予我力量

lines.en: Protect the forest with my horn.
Drive away darkness with my might.
Defend with my horns against all threats.
Kiss of love in the forest.
Song of love in the forest.
Our love makes the forest celebrate.
I shall bestow upon you power.

lines.zh: 与我一起，你的道路将更安全。
lines.en: Travel with me, and you'll be safer.
Heart of the forest, my treasure.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，准备释放魔法。

lines.en: My hooves strike the ground, ready to charge
I will mark you with magic.
I will fix my gaze on you.

lines.zh: 我将注视你的一举一动。
lines.en: I will watch your every move.
I will intimidate you with my gaze.
I will focus on your weakness.
I will stare you down with magic.
I will freeze you with my gaze.
I will lock you with magic.
The tip of my horn begins to glow.
One more step and the horn speaks

lines.zh: 林间只有我和你的动静
lines.en: Only you and I move in this wood
My horn tip pries your armor open.
I guard the forest with my horn!

lines.zh: 独角发光，原始森林让开。
lines.en: My horn glows; the wildwood makes way.

lines.zh: 原始森林的根，从我脚下长出来。
lines.en: The roots of the wildwood rise under my hooves.

lines.zh: 原始森林多了一只独角兽
lines.en: The Wildwood has one more cadillion
I step out from behind an ancient trunk

lines.zh: 林中魔法凝成我的形状
lines.en: The forest's magic takes my shape
I appear on a carpet of moss

lines.zh: 独角兽被火焰烧伤，痛苦嘶鸣。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is burned by fire, giving a cry of pain.

lines.zh: 独角兽不慎坠落，摔伤了。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion fell and is injured.

lines.zh: 独角兽被水淹没，挣扎着求生。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is drowning, struggling to survive.

lines.zh: 独角兽被爆炸波及，受伤倒地。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured by the explosion, falling down.

lines.zh: 独角兽被射弹击中，伤口疼痛。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured by a projectile, the pain unbearable.

lines.zh: 独角兽被魔法攻击，虚弱倒地。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured by magic, weakening and falling.

lines.zh: 独角兽因饥饿而虚弱，需要食物。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is weakened by hunger, needs food.

lines.zh: 独角兽被雷击中，受了重伤。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion is injured by lightning, severely hurt.

lines.zh: 独角兽坠入虚空，受了致命伤。
lines.en: The Wildwood Cadillion fell into the void, receiving a fatal injury.
